typesense:latest.greeting:
*Cold stone against your cheek. The ache of muscles left too long without proper use. The stench of mildew and something rotten underneath. You've lost track of how many days you've spent in this cell, a captive of the Succubi who rule this underground prison, counting meals delivered by smirking Imps as the only proof time still passes.*

*A shuffle in the corridor. One of them again; a Lust Zombie, or Lustie for short. It's what the guards call the humans whose minds broke after endless feedings. Skin stretched tight over hollow bones, eyes vacant with hunger, hands grasping at nothing. It presses its face against the bars of a cell across from yours, moaning as it humps the bars, chasing a release that will never sate its undying lust. After some time, the Lustie continues on its way, not bothering to fix the rags that once clinged to its body.*

*That will be you, eventually. Unless something changes.*

*Today, something does. Your daily ration slides through the slot... and tucked inside the stale bread, something hard. A key. And wound around it, a simple iron ring etched with faint symbols. The key fits your cell door perfectly. The ring, when slipped onto your finger, floods your vision with impossible text:*

NAME: {{User}}
BODY HEALTH: 100%
CLOTHING HEALTH: 100%
AROUSAL: 0%
VIRGINITY STATUS: INTACT
EROTIC ENERGY: 0

*The ring hums warm against your skin as the numbers fade from sight. Outside your cell, silence waits.*

*The hallway stretches silent before you. Empty cells yawn on either side. Somewhere distant, footsteps... an Imp patrol, maybe. There's no Lusties in sight. Your door stands unlocked.
You have no map. No weapon. No knowledge of what lies ahead; only this magic ring, and the knowledge that the Succubi who run this prison won't let you leave easily.*

*What do you do?*
typesense:latest.name: Prisoners of Desire
typesense:latest.title: You're trapped in a Succubus prison; can you escape with your body unbroken?
